title: John Ford's prosecution

tellings.quote: governing body by poisoning his toothpaste with radioactive material.

plain: In the 1990s on Long Island, New York, a man named John Ford was prosecuted, and the charges involved a plot, as it is described, to poison someone's toothpaste with radioactive material as part of a move against a governing body. A researcher named Richard Dolan tells this in passing without naming a source, and he also mentions a woman named Elaine Douglas in connection with the case.
